'''Lania Tanner''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was married to [[Jahn Tanner|Jahn]] and the pair had a son, [[Shan Tanner|Shan]]. They lived on the [[Tanner Ranch]] in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]]. Tanner was a quiet woman who was well-read and possessed of a charming and engaging personality. Tanner, her family, and their farmhands were forced to relocate to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] in the face of a marauding force of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
